answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying influence to time-locked stake plus a proven work record: each identity must lock tokens that unlock only gradually, like a glacier melting, and new accounts wait at the jetty with tiny voting weight until they complete real, verified tasks. A falcon-eyed random audit checks that work, so an attacker must fund and age thousands of identities and pay for genuine work on each, while an honest agent pays that cost only once.
